issues.title: Freeze closeout scope against horizon creep
issues.why: The repo already has the nouns. The next risk is widening instead of finishing.
acceptance: Repo-level docs say this pass deepens bounded slices rather than 'implements v16-v20'.

issues.title: Add crate-local README and AGENTS files for each new horizon crate
issues.why: The new crates own real artifact families but have no local operating docs.
acceptance: Each new crate states owned artifacts, non-goals, and required test/fixture discipline.

issues.title: Add shared replay artifact and bounded replay evaluator
issues.why: The current v16 slice proves downgrade under missing replay, but replay is still implicit rather than first-class.
acceptance: `SharedReplaySliceV1` exists with schema, fixtures, and test coverage.
Missing replay still degrades explicitly rather than silently settling.

issues.title: Add divergence and suspension artifacts
issues.why: The v16 spec build order explicitly calls for divergence and suspension after replay.
acceptance: A failing settlement family can emit suspension with explicit blast radius and resumption requirements.

issues.title: Widen kernel-conformance for v16 replay and suspension
issues.why: The current interpreter tests only cover settlement downgrade and local dissent preservation.
acceptance: Reference interpreters expose replay admissibility and suspension behavior for v16.

issues.title: Upgrade fit evaluation to consume refuter suite and stability report
issues.why: Current v17 fit logic is mostly a boolean gate. The richer artifacts exist but are not meaningfully consumed.
acceptance: Fit readiness uses `TheoryRefuterSuiteV1` and `RolloutStabilityReportV1`, not only `refuter_present: bool`.

issues.title: Add v17 reference interpreter and manifest/schema sync for richer fit slices
issues.why: The richer v17 evaluator needs conformance and schema proof, not just crate-local tests.
acceptance: v17 interpreter proves promotion blocking when refuters or stability are missing.

issues.title: Make portfolio selection information-value aware
issues.why: The current portfolio evaluator is mostly sequential budget subtraction.
acceptance: Selection/defer decisions mention information gain, review cost, and budget pressure explicitly.

issues.title: Link ProgramHypothesisSet and add overload receipts
issues.why: Program hypotheses exist as a type but are not yet part of the bounded selection story.
acceptance: Budget exhaustion produces explicit pause/defer output with hypothesis/program linkage still visible.

issues.title: Bind amendment decisions to semantic diff and archive consequences
issues.why: The current amendment evaluator blocks on rollback but does not yet bind the change to diff/archive artifacts.
acceptance: Amendment decisions can carry or strongly reference semantic diff and archive consequences.

issues.title: Add archive/compaction evaluator and historical-query guarantees to conformance
issues.why: Archive and compaction are typed but not yet behaviorally proven in a closeout slice.
acceptance: A compaction path preserves an explicit historical query guarantee and visible degradation note.

issues.title: Add SelfHostingBuildReceiptV1 end-to-end
issues.why: The v20 build order names it, but the codebase currently has no ID, type, schema, or fixture for it.
acceptance: `SelfHostingBuildReceiptV1` exists with ID, schema, fixture, and at least one test.

issues.title: Generate interpreter, conformance corpus, and migration companion bundles
issues.why: Current generation only produces a schema bundle. The companion generated artifacts are still empty nouns.
acceptance: One call path emits generated schema/interpreter/corpus/migration companion bundles with backpointers.

issues.title: Add veto, meta challenge, and rollback baseline
issues.why: The current code defines `HumanVetoBundleV1` and `MetaChallengeBundleV1` as inert data only.
acceptance: Generated artifacts can be vetoed or challenged with explicit rollback-visible state.

issues.title: Keep schema generator, manifests, and fixtures in sync
issues.why: Every new artifact family in this pass must be schema-owned and listed in the correct manifest.
acceptance: `cargo run -p contract-schema-gen -- --check schemas` passes after the new artifacts land.

issues.title: Update repo-level status docs to match the finished bounded slices
issues.why: The repo already contains many pack docs; they need one post-pass truth pass.
acceptance: Repo-level status docs name what is real in code and what remains scaffold/horizon.
